s0301.literal: Members of the Central Secretariat requested payment in notes of one hundred two thousand ingots as the price for treasures sold over successive reigns by Hasan and others; it was approved.
s0301.idiomatic: Members of the Central Secretariat requested payment in notes of 102,000 ingots as the price for treasures sold over successive reigns by Hasan and others; it was approved.

s0302.literal: On renxu day the imperial carriage visited Shangdu.
s0302.idiomatic: On renxu day the imperial carriage visited Shangdu.

s0303.literal: Six deputy directors of the Armory Directorate were again established.
s0303.idiomatic: Six deputy directors of the Armory Directorate were again established.

s0304.literal: Prince Bala Temür was ordered to go out and garrison Chaghan Na'ur.
s0304.idiomatic: Prince Bala Temür was ordered to go out and garrison Chaghan Na'ur.

s0305.literal: Kuanche was enfeoffed Duke of the State, and Ashan Huozhe was appointed to manage Privy Council affairs.
s0305.idiomatic: Kuanche was enfeoffed Duke of the State, and Ashan Huozhe was appointed to manage Privy Council affairs.

s0306.literal: The Hun River burst its banks; ten thousand troops and civilians were mobilized to block it.
s0306.idiomatic: The Hun River burst its banks; 10,000 troops and civilians were mobilized to block it.

s0307.literal: On dingmao day Mars encroached upon Well.
s0307.idiomatic: On dingmao day Mars encroached upon Well.

s0308.literal: The Imperial Carriage Guard Direct Command was reestablished at the rank of regular fourth grade.
s0308.idiomatic: The Imperial Carriage Guard Direct Command was reestablished at the rank of regular fourth grade.

s0309.literal: Prince Busayin dispatched envoys presenting a leopard and a lion; eight thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0309.idiomatic: Prince Busayin dispatched envoys presenting a leopard and a lion; 8,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0310.literal: Dependent counties of the two routes Daning and Guangping suffered famine; twenty-eight thousand ingots of notes were granted in relief.
s0310.idiomatic: Dependent counties of the two routes Daning and Guangping suffered famine; 28,000 ingots of notes were granted in relief.

s0311.literal: Various prefectures and counties of Henan Province and dependent counties of Jianning suffered famine; relief grain was granted in varying amounts.
s0311.idiomatic: Various prefectures and counties of Henan Province and dependent counties of Jianning suffered famine; relief grain was granted in varying amounts.

s0312.literal: Fourth month of summer, on xinwei day, thieves entered the Imperial Ancestral Temple and stole Emperor Wuzong's golden spirit tablet and sacrificial vessels.
s0312.idiomatic: Fourth month of summer, on xinwei day, thieves entered the Imperial Ancestral Temple and stole Emperor Wuzong's golden spirit tablet and sacrificial vessels.

s0313.literal: Chief Ani of Ludian in Dali raided.
s0313.idiomatic: Chief Ani of Ludian in Dali raided.

s0314.literal: On renshen day Emperor Wuzong's spirit tablet was made.
s0314.idiomatic: On renshen day Emperor Wuzong's spirit tablet was made.

s0315.literal: On jiaxu day the Palm-Fiber Deer-Antler Topped Tower was built.
s0315.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the Palm-Fiber Deer-Antler Topped Tower was built.

s0316.literal: On jimao day the Yao of Yongming County, Daozhou, raided.
s0316.idiomatic: On jimao day the Yao of Yongming County, Daozhou, raided.

s0317.literal: On guiwei day the sea at Yan'guan Prefecture overflowed, encroaching nineteen li of land; Supervising Commissioner of Waterworks Zhang Zhongren and provincial officials were ordered to mobilize over twenty thousand craftsmen to block it with bamboo cages, wooden palisades, and packed stones; it did not stop.
s0317.idiomatic: On guiwei day the sea at Yan'guan Prefecture overflowed, encroaching 19 li of land; Supervising Commissioner of Waterworks Zhang Zhongren and provincial officials were ordered to mobilize over 20,000 craftsmen to block it with bamboo cages, wooden palisades, and packed stones; it did not stop.

s0318.literal: On guisi day the Yao of Gaozhou raided Dianbai County; qianhu Zhang Heng fought fiercely and died; the townspeople erected a shrine, and an edict granted the plaque inscription "Commending Righteousness."
s0318.idiomatic: On guisi day the Yao of Gaozhou raided Dianbai County; qianhu Zhang Heng fought fiercely and died; the townspeople erected a shrine, and an edict granted the plaque inscription "Commending Righteousness."

s0319.literal: On jiawu day the Western monk Gonggrelba Chongnasi Jianzang Banzangbu was made Imperial Preceptor, granted a jade seal, and an edict was also issued instructing all monks under Heaven.
s0319.idiomatic: On jiawu day the Western monk Gonggrelba Chongnasi Jianzang Banzangbu was made Imperial Preceptor, granted a jade seal, and an edict was also issued instructing all monks under Heaven.

s0320.literal: On yiwei day the Director of the Armory Directorate Ashi'er Dalahan was appointed Censor-in-Chief.
s0320.idiomatic: On yiwei day the Director of the Armory Directorate Ashi'er Dalahan was appointed Censor-in-Chief.

s0321.literal: A comet appeared at the Muslim Astronomy Observatory.
s0321.idiomatic: A comet appeared at the Muslim Astronomy Observatory.

s0322.literal: The Yao of Huguang raided Quanzhou and dependent counties of Yining; garrison commanders were ordered to capture them.
s0322.idiomatic: The Yao of Huguang raided Quanzhou and dependent counties of Yining; garrison commanders were ordered to capture them.

s0323.literal: The two routes Henan and Fengyuan, prefectures including Tong, Shun, Tan, and Ji, and counties including Yuyang, Baodi, and Xianghe suffered famine; two months' grain was granted.
s0323.idiomatic: The two routes Henan and Fengyuan, prefectures including Tong, Shun, Tan, and Ji, and counties including Yuyang, Baodi, and Xianghe suffered famine; 2 months' grain was granted.

s0324.literal: Dependent counties of routes Hejian, Yangzhou, Jianning, Taiping, Quzhou, and Changzhou, and the two routes Wusa and Wuding in Yunnan suffered famine; relief grain and notes were granted in varying amounts.
s0324.idiomatic: Dependent counties of routes Hejian, Yangzhou, Jianning, Taiping, Quzhou, and Changzhou, and the two routes Wusa and Wuding in Yunnan suffered famine; relief grain and notes were granted in varying amounts.

s0325.literal: Yongping Route suffered famine; its rent was remitted and two months' relief grain was still granted.
s0325.idiomatic: Yongping Route suffered famine; its rent was remitted and 2 months' relief grain was still granted.

s0326.literal: Fifth month, on xinchou day, Grand Commandant Choulu died.
s0326.idiomatic: Fifth month, on xinchou day, Grand Commandant Choulu died.

s0327.literal: On guimao day, because the sea at Yan'guan Prefecture overflowed, Celestial Master Zhang Sicheng was ordered to perform Daoist rites of supplication.
s0327.idiomatic: On guimao day, because the sea at Yan'guan Prefecture overflowed, Celestial Master Zhang Sicheng was ordered to perform Daoist rites of supplication.

s0328.literal: On yisi day the Spirit Hall of Emperor Chengzong was completed at the Tianshou Wanning Temple.
s0328.idiomatic: On yisi day the Spirit Hall of Emperor Chengzong was completed at the Tianshou Wanning Temple.

s0329.literal: On jiwei day Champa dispatched envoys presenting tribute goods.
s0329.idiomatic: On jiwei day Champa dispatched envoys presenting tribute goods.

s0330.literal: On jiazi day, because guardianship of the Imperial Ancestral Temple was not strict, officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices were dismissed.
s0330.idiomatic: On jiazi day, because guardianship of the Imperial Ancestral Temple was not strict, officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices were dismissed.

s0331.literal: On dingmao day Buddhist rites were performed at Helan Mountain and various imperial traveling palaces.
s0331.idiomatic: On dingmao day Buddhist rites were performed at Helan Mountain and various imperial traveling palaces.

s0332.literal: The hereditary succession of prefecture and county chiefs in princes' fief territories was abolished; they were made like regularly assigned officials, with three years as the term of evaluation.
s0332.idiomatic: The hereditary succession of prefecture and county chiefs in princes' fief territories was abolished; they were made like regularly assigned officials, with 3 years as the term of evaluation.

s0333.literal: Route commander Pushuang of Yuanjiang Route was dismissed for corruption; he then rallied tribal troops and rebelled; an edict restored him to his former office.
s0333.idiomatic: Route commander Pushuang of Yuanjiang Route was dismissed for corruption; he then rallied tribal troops and rebelled; an edict restored him to his former office.

s0334.literal: The Yao of Deqing Route submitted; men and women they had seized were returned, all being given back to their relatives.
s0334.idiomatic: The Yao of Deqing Route submitted; men and women they had seized were returned, all being given back to their relatives.

s0335.literal: Dependent counties of Henan and Jiangling suffered famine; relief grain was granted in varying amounts.
s0335.idiomatic: Dependent counties of Henan and Jiangling suffered famine; relief grain was granted in varying amounts.

s0336.literal: Dependent counties of Bianliang suffered famine; their rent was remitted.
s0336.idiomatic: Dependent counties of Bianliang suffered famine; their rent was remitted.

s0337.literal: The two routes Changzhou and Huai'an, Ninghai Prefecture suffered heavy hail; the river at Suizhou overflowed; dependent counties of routes Dadu, Nanyang, Runing, and Luzhou suffered drought and locusts; Weihui Route had great wind for nine days and trees were all uprooted.
s0337.idiomatic: The two routes Changzhou and Huai'an, Ninghai Prefecture suffered heavy hail; the river at Suizhou overflowed; dependent counties of routes Dadu, Nanyang, Runing, and Luzhou suffered drought and locusts; Weihui Route had great wind for 9 days and trees were all uprooted.

s0338.literal: In Luoyang County of Henan Route there were locusts covering about five mu; after flocks of crows ate them, within several days the locusts gathered again and were eaten again.
s0338.idiomatic: In Luoyang County of Henan Route there were locusts covering about 5 mu; after flocks of crows ate them, within several days the locusts gathered again and were eaten again.

s0339.literal: Sixth month, on xinwei day, Hanlin Lecturer-in-Waiting Aruwei, Associate Academician Yanchi, and others lectured; they were also ordered to translate the Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government and submit it.
s0339.idiomatic: Sixth month, on xinwei day, Hanlin Lecturer-in-Waiting Aruwei, Associate Academician Yanchi, and others lectured; they were also ordered to translate the Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government and submit it.

s0340.literal: Vice Grand Councillor Shi Weiliang requested to resign and return home to care for his parents; it was not granted.
s0340.idiomatic: Vice Grand Councillor Shi Weiliang requested to resign and return home to care for his parents; it was not granted.

s0341.literal: On dingchou day Dowlatash and others requested dismissal on account of calamities and omens; it was not granted.
s0341.idiomatic: On dingchou day Dowlatash and others requested dismissal on account of calamities and omens; it was not granted.

s0342.literal: Construction corvée at the two capitals was halted; prisoners held in various prefectures were recorded.
s0342.idiomatic: Construction corvée at the two capitals was halted; prisoners held in various prefectures were recorded.

s0343.literal: On jimao day Yongxing Garrison Farm suffered disaster; its rent was remitted.
s0343.idiomatic: On jimao day Yongxing Garrison Farm suffered disaster; its rent was remitted.

s0344.literal: On xinsi day six elephant palanquins were made.
s0344.idiomatic: On xinsi day 6 elephant palanquins were made.

s0345.literal: On guiwei day Chana and Bayan were dispatched to Dadu for appointment selection.
s0345.idiomatic: On guiwei day Chana and Bayan were dispatched to Dadu for appointment selection.

s0346.literal: On jiashen day the Hua-jiao tribes of Guangxi raided; local forces were ordered to suppress them.
s0346.idiomatic: On jiashen day the Hua-jiao tribes of Guangxi raided; local forces were ordered to suppress them.

s0347.literal: On yiwei day chiefs Aze and others of the Four Caves of Shaoqing Route submitted; all were appointed tribal chiefs, and inspection offices were also established to pacify them.
s0347.idiomatic: On yiwei day chiefs Aze and others of the Four Caves of Shaoqing Route submitted; all were appointed tribal chiefs, and inspection offices were also established to pacify them.

s0348.literal: Charity-granary grain was issued to relieve the people of Yan'guan Prefecture.
s0348.idiomatic: Charity-granary grain was issued to relieve the people of Yan'guan Prefecture.

s0349.literal: Luzhou Route suffered famine; seventy-nine thousand shi of relief grain was granted.
s0349.idiomatic: Luzhou Route suffered famine; 79,000 shi of relief grain was granted.

s0350.literal: The two routes Zhenjiang and Xingguo suffered famine; relief grain for sale was granted in varying amounts.
s0350.idiomatic: The two routes Zhenjiang and Xingguo suffered famine; relief grain for sale was granted in varying amounts.

s0351.literal: Zhongshan Prefecture suffered hail; the river at Bianliang Route burst its banks; Runing Prefecture suffered drought; dependent counties of Dadu, Hejian, Jinan, Daming, and Xiazhou suffered locusts.
s0351.idiomatic: Zhongshan Prefecture suffered hail; the river at Bianliang Route burst its banks; Runing Prefecture suffered drought; dependent counties of Dadu, Hejian, Jinan, Daming, and Xiazhou suffered locusts.

s0352.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on dingyou day, Pushuang of Yuanjiang Route rebelled again.
s0352.idiomatic: Seventh month of autumn, on dingyou day, Pushuang of Yuanjiang Route rebelled again.

s0353.literal: On wuxu day Prince Yanzhi Jitai succeeded to his title and dispatched envoys to court.
s0353.idiomatic: On wuxu day Prince Yanzhi Jitai succeeded to his title and dispatched envoys to court.

s0354.literal: On jihai day Huanghu of the Ba'erhu tribe presented tribute goods.
s0354.idiomatic: On jihai day Huanghu of the Ba'erhu tribe presented tribute goods.

s0355.literal: Censorate officials said: "In the inner prefectures and Jiangnan drought and locusts occur one after another — this is no minor matter of state; Grand Councillor Tash Temür, Dowlatash, Vice Grand Councillors Buhua and Shi Weiliang, and Administrative Assistant Mainu all request resignation."
s0355.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "In the inner prefectures and Jiangnan drought and locusts occur one after another — this is no minor matter of state; Grand Councillor Tash Temür, Dowlatash, Vice Grand Councillors Buhua and Shi Weiliang, and Administrative Assistant Mainu all request resignation."

s0356.literal: An imperial directive stated: "Do not decline excessively; I shall examine myself, and you too should each reverently perform your duties.
s0356.idiomatic: An imperial directive stated, "Do not decline excessively; I shall examine myself, and you too should each reverently perform your duties.

s0359.literal: A Hengqu Academy was built in Mei County to enshrine the Song scholar Zhang Zai.
s0359.idiomatic: A Hengqu Academy was built in Mei County to enshrine the Song scholar Zhang Zai.

s0360.literal: On xinchou day Prince of Qi Yueyue Temür was granted twenty thousand ingots of notes.
s0360.idiomatic: On xinchou day Prince of Qi Yueyue Temür was granted 20,000 ingots of notes.

s0361.literal: On jiachen day the Bozhou tribesman Xie Wuqiong came to present tribute goods.
s0361.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Bozhou tribesman Xie Wuqiong came to present tribute goods.

s0362.literal: On bingwu day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0362.idiomatic: On bingwu day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0363.literal: On dingwei day an edict stated: "Lecture officials of the Classics Colloquium may not leave office without a replacement.
s0363.idiomatic: On dingwei day an edict stated, "Lecture officials of the Classics Colloquium may not leave office without a replacement.

s0364.literal: " An edict instructed the Imperial Clan Court that adjudication of cases should follow Emperor Shizu's old institutions.
s0364.idiomatic: An edict instructed the Imperial Clan Court that adjudication of cases should follow Emperor Shizu's old institutions.

s0365.literal: On wuxu day Hanlin Reader-in-Waiting Aruwei was dispatched back to Dadu to translate the Sacred Instructions of Emperor Shizu.
s0365.idiomatic: On wuxu day Hanlin Reader-in-Waiting Aruwei was dispatched back to Dadu to translate the Sacred Instructions of Emperor Shizu.

s0366.literal: On renzi day Princes Huo'erhui, Yue Temür, and Bala Temür and the imperial son-in-law Maizhuhan were granted fifteen thousand ingots of notes, with gold, silver, coins, and silk in varying amounts.
s0366.idiomatic: On renzi day Princes Huo'erhui, Yue Temür, and Bala Temür and the imperial son-in-law Maizhuhan were granted 15,000 ingots of notes, with gold, silver, coins, and silk in varying amounts.

s0367.literal: On jiayin day envoys were dispatched to purchase yak in the Western Regions.
s0367.idiomatic: On jiayin day envoys were dispatched to purchase yak in the Western Regions.

s0368.literal: On dingsi day a seal was issued to Prince of Qi Yue Temür.
s0368.idiomatic: On dingsi day a seal was issued to Prince of Qi Yue Temür.

s0369.literal: Bayancha'er and Wubadula requested to resign from government on account of illness; an edict of favor instructed them.
s0369.idiomatic: Bayancha'er and Wubadula requested to resign from government on account of illness; an edict of favor instructed them.

s0370.literal: On wuwu day the native official Saiqiuluo of Mouzhan Route persuaded the Babai Xifu tribesman Zhao Sanjin to submit; the Yinsaluo native official Sanqiezhe killed Saiqiuluo; the Prince of Yunnan was ordered to send someone to instruct him.
s0370.idiomatic: On wuwu day the native official Saiqiuluo of Mouzhan Route persuaded the Babai Xifu tribesman Zhao Sanjin to submit; the Yinsaluo native official Sanqiezhe killed Saiqiuluo; the Prince of Yunnan was ordered to send someone to instruct him.

s0371.literal: On guihai day Princess Shouning was granted five thousand ingots of notes.
s0371.idiomatic: On guihai day Princess Shouning was granted 5,000 ingots of notes.

s0372.literal: Prince of Qi Suonanguanbu complained that Prince of Jing Yesu Tuogan had encroached on his fief lands; Gansu Province was ordered to review registers and return them.
s0372.idiomatic: Prince of Qi Suonanguanbu complained that Prince of Jing Yesu Tuogan had encroached on his fief lands; Gansu Province was ordered to review registers and return them.

s0373.literal: On yichou day Prince of Zhou Husih Lie and Princes Yanzhi Getai and others came to present tribute; gold, silver, notes, and coins were granted in varying amounts.
s0373.idiomatic: On yichou day Prince of Zhou Husih Lie and Princes Yanzhi Getai and others came to present tribute; gold, silver, notes, and coins were granted in varying amounts.

s0374.literal: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the Sea God Tianfei.
s0374.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice to the Sea God Tianfei.

s0375.literal: On bingyin day monks and Daoists who had wives were registered as commoners.
s0375.idiomatic: On bingyin day monks and Daoists who had wives were registered as commoners.

s0376.literal: The Bao'an Canal was blocked; six thousand civilian laborers were conscripted.
s0376.idiomatic: The Bao'an Canal was blocked; 6,000 civilian laborers were conscripted.

s0377.literal: That month the sacrificial fields suffered locusts, and the Heishui River in Yun Prefecture overflowed.
s0377.idiomatic: That month the sacrificial fields suffered locusts, and the Heishui River in Yun Prefecture overflowed.

s0378.literal: Quzhou suffered great rain and flooding; granaries were opened to relieve the hungry, and coffins were provided for those drowned.
s0378.idiomatic: Quzhou suffered great rain and flooding; granaries were opened to relieve the hungry, and coffins were provided for those drowned.

s0379.literal: Dependent counties of Yan'an suffered drought; their rent and tax were remitted.
s0379.idiomatic: Dependent counties of Yan'an suffered drought; their rent and tax were remitted.

s0380.literal: The Liao River and Laosajia River in Liaoyang overflowed; the Right Guard Command department suffered famine; relief was granted for all.
s0380.idiomatic: The Liao River and Laosajia River in Liaoyang overflowed; the Right Guard Command department suffered famine; relief was granted for all.

s0381.literal: Eighth month, on wuchen day notes for successive reigns' ordos were granted in varying amounts.
s0381.idiomatic: Eighth month, on wuchen day notes for successive reigns' ordos were granted in varying amounts.

s0382.literal: On guiyou day a seal for Duke of State Bieqilieshi was issued.
s0382.idiomatic: On guiyou day a seal for Duke of State Bieqilieshi was issued.

s0383.literal: Commissioner of the Revenue Board Boluo requested to resign to care for his mother; it was not granted.
s0383.idiomatic: Commissioner of the Revenue Board Boluo requested to resign to care for his mother; it was not granted.

s0384.literal: The Empress's wet nurse was granted one thousand seven hundred ingots of notes.
s0384.idiomatic: The Empress's wet nurse was granted 1,700 ingots of notes.

s0385.literal: The Hutuo River overflowed; laborers were mobilized to dredge the river and reduce its force.
s0385.idiomatic: The Hutuo River overflowed; laborers were mobilized to dredge the river and reduce its force.

s0386.literal: Single Hu, acting administrator of Fengyuan Route, said that ordering the people to hunt and capture rare birds and exotic beasts was inconvenient and requested its abolition; an edict stated: "Those required for the hunt should capture them and present them.
s0386.idiomatic: Single Hu, acting administrator of Fengyuan Route, said that ordering the people to hunt and capture rare birds and exotic beasts was inconvenient and requested its abolition; an edict stated, "Those required for the hunt should capture them and present them.

s0387.literal: " On yihai day Princess Badashini's dowry-household was granted four thousand ingots of notes.
s0387.idiomatic: On yihai day Princess Badashini's dowry-household was granted 4,000 ingots of notes.

s0388.literal: The Miao tribesman Ji Boyang raided Lituo Stockade; Huguang Province was ordered to capture him.
s0388.idiomatic: The Miao tribesman Ji Boyang raided Lituo Stockade; Huguang Province was ordered to capture him.

s0389.literal: On gengchen day one hundred thousand shi of grain was transported and stored in granaries along the river, to prepare for famine in inner prefectures.
s0389.idiomatic: On gengchen day 100,000 shi of grain was transported and stored in granaries along the river, to prepare for famine in inner prefectures.

s0390.literal: The cave Yao of Tianzhou raided; Huguang Province was dispatched to capture them.
s0390.idiomatic: The cave Yao of Tianzhou raided; Huguang Province was dispatched to capture them.

s0391.literal: On guiwei day Prince of Ying Yexian Temür was granted three thousand ingots of notes.
s0391.idiomatic: On guiwei day Prince of Ying Yexian Temür was granted 3,000 ingots of notes.

s0392.literal: On yiyou day the Qinming Hall built at the Bo'ye Ordo was completed.
s0392.idiomatic: On yiyou day the Qinming Hall built at the Bo'ye Ordo was completed.

s0393.literal: On renchen day Censor Li Chang said: "Henan Province Chief Councillor Tongtong, whose family has long held office in Henan, greatly seeks illicit profit; request that he be transferred to another post.
s0393.idiomatic: On renchen day Censor Li Chang said, "Henan Province Chief Councillor Tongtong, whose family has long held office in Henan, greatly seeks illicit profit; request that he be transferred to another post.

s0395.literal: On guisi day posthumous titles were granted to Empress Wuzong as Xuan Ci Hui Sheng and to Empress Yingzong as Zhuang Jing Yi Sheng; their spirit tablets were elevated and enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0395.idiomatic: On guisi day posthumous titles were granted to Empress Wuzong as Xuan Ci Hui Sheng and to Empress Yingzong as Zhuang Jing Yi Sheng; their spirit tablets were elevated and enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0396.literal: Eight thousand guard troops were mobilized to repair the dikes of the Baifu and Wengshan Rivers.
s0396.idiomatic: 8,000 guard troops were mobilized to repair the dikes of the Baifu and Wengshan Rivers.

s0397.literal: That month the sea at Chongming Prefecture and Haimen County of Yangzhou Route overflowed; the river at Fugou and Lanyang counties of Bianliang Route overflowed, inundating people's fields and dwellings; relief was granted for all.
s0397.idiomatic: That month the sea at Chongming Prefecture and Haimen County of Yangzhou Route overflowed; the river at Fugou and Lanyang counties of Bianliang Route overflowed, inundating people's fields and dwellings; relief was granted for all.

s0398.literal: Dependent counties of Jiande, Hangzhou, and Quzhou suffered flooding; garrison farms in routes Zhending, Jinning, Yan'an, Henan, and others suffered drought; routes Dadu, Hejian, Fengyuan, and Huaiqing suffered locusts; Tongwei County in Gongchang Prefecture suffered a mountain collapse.
s0398.idiomatic: Dependent counties of Jiande, Hangzhou, and Quzhou suffered flooding; garrison farms in routes Zhending, Jinning, Yan'an, Henan, and others suffered drought; routes Dadu, Hejian, Fengyuan, and Huaiqing suffered locusts; Tongwei County in Gongchang Prefecture suffered a mountain collapse.

s0399.literal: At Diaomen there was an earthquake; sound like thunder; daytime turned dark.
s0399.idiomatic: At Diaomen there was an earthquake; sound like thunder; daytime turned dark.

s0400.literal: In Tianquan Circuit a mountain collapsed; flying stones killed people.
s0400.idiomatic: In Tianquan Circuit a mountain collapsed; flying stones killed people.
